event.title: Courier Relay
event.description: A navigation message from {subject} is waiting in {sector}. Relay it or keep moving.

choices.label: Relay the message
choices.story: {crewlist} restores the link to {subject} and forwards the waiting message.

choices.label: Continue the voyage
choices.story: The crew leaves {subject} transmitting into the quiet.

event.failureStory: The transmission fades before the link is restored.
